_source.describes: The hexcrawl Locations generator: FLAIL!'s five d20 axes.
_source.status: Unofficial. Not affiliated with Games Omnivorous.
_source.rationale: FLAIL!'s own Locations table, reproduced in face order, which the Third-Party Licence permits. Kept on its own field paths rather than sharing Biome, Condition, Key Feature and Occupant with the Landmarks generator. Checked against the book, column by column: Condition and Key Feature have no row in common with the Landmarks table, Occupant shares only the face-20 catch-all, and Biome is identical throughout. The identical rows are copied here rather than shared, because a lock stores a table position and not a phrase — one shared path would let a Biome locked on a Landmark resolve, on switching to a Location, against whichever row sat at that index, with nothing on screen to show it. The Biome column repeats entries deliberately — the book spans each biome across two or four rows, so a d20 is weighted towards the commoner ones.
